title: China Blockades Taiwan... and the First Nuke Since 1945 Is Fired
description:
Day one: a Chinese coast guard cutter orders a gas tanker off Kaohsiung to stop for inspection. Taiwan has about 11 days of gas. This is a day-by-day simulation of how a "quarantine" of Taiwan could become a blockade, a war at sea, and on day 23 the first nuclear weapon used in war since Nagasaki, built from real forces, real wargames and published blast models.

This is a simulation. It has not happened. The China Coast Guard patrols that begin it are real: they started east of Taiwan in October 2026. Scenario segments are labelled SIMULATION on screen; facts are labelled REAL DATA or REAL HISTORY.

Chapters

7:02 Day twenty-three

Key sources
- CSIS, Lights Out? Wargaming a Chinese Blockade of Taiwan (2025): https://www.csis.org/analysis/lights-out-wargaming-chinese-blockade-taiwan
- CSIS, How China Could Quarantine Taiwan (2024): https://www.csis.org/analysis/how-china-could-quarantine-taiwan-mapping-out-two-possible-scenarios
- CSIS and MIT, Confronting Armageddon (2024): https://www.csis.org/analysis/confronting-armageddon
- CSIS, Taiwan's energy security (2026): https://www.csis.org/analysis/iran-conflict-illuminates-taiwans-unique-energy-security-challenge
- FAS on the Pentagon's 2025 China report: https://fas.org/publication/the-pentagons-slimmed-down-2025-china-military-power-report/
- US State Department, the Taiwan Strait crises: https://history.state.gov/milestones/1953-1960/taiwan-strait-crises
- Reuters on the October 2026 coast guard patrols: https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2026-10-31/chinas-coast-guard-conducts-patrols-east-of-taiwan-cctv-reports
Economic figures: Bloomberg Economics (February 2026). Blast and burn figures: Glasstone and Dolan, The Effects of Nuclear Weapons (1977), calibrated to NUKEMAP by Alex Wellerstein.

How this video was made: the narration is AI-generated (Google Text-to-Speech). Scenario segments are simulations built from published models and open sources; the day-by-day events, launch site, target and yield are ours, a scenario, not a forecast.
Maps: Natural Earth (public domain), OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) via OpenFreeMap and OpenMapTiles. Imagery: NASA Blue Marble and Black Marble. Music: generated with Eleven Music.
